read.thesis: UPS beat Q3 and raised FY26 revenue to ~$92.6B and operating profit to ~$8.75B, with U.S. Domestic margin up 60bp to 7.0% as Amazon volume exits and RPP outpaces CPP.

capex.quote: Capital expenditures are still expected to be about $3 billion.

triggers.label: RPP beats CPP by 60bp
triggers.quote: the growth in revenue per piece was 60 basis points higher than the growth in cost per piece

triggers.label: FY26 revenue and op profit raised
triggers.quote: we now expect consolidated revenue of approximately $92.6 billion and consolidated operating profit of approximately $8.75 billion

triggers.label: Core volume ex-Amazon up ~2%
triggers.quote: our core volume, so the volume outside of Amazon, grew nearly 2%

triggers.label: International ADV down 8.7%
triggers.quote: total international average daily volume declined 8.7% compared to the third quarter of last year, primarily due to geopolitical tensions

guidance.value: $3B total cost savings target, $1.8B achieved through September

red_flags.label: Core U.S. volume still down; total ADV -3.3%
red_flags.quote: Looking at total ADV in the U.S., it was down 3.3% versus the third quarter of last year

red_flags.label: International volume down 8.7%
red_flags.quote: total international average daily volume declined 8.7% compared to the third quarter of last year

red_flags.label: Goodwill impairment in SCS
red_flags.quote: a $182 million charge associated with a goodwill impairment in Supply Chain Solutions

evasions.quote: We are not going to give guidance today. We are going to do that at the end of the fourth quarter like we always do.
As it relates to Amazon itself, first of all, we have a really interesting relationship with Amazon
